problem_statement: RIOT must provide a thread flags group capability, selectable through `core_thread_flags_group`, that lets one thread set thread flags for several waiting threads at once without needing their individual PIDs. It must provide a `thread_flags_group_t` type, initialized with `THREAD_FLAGS_GROUP_INIT`, and functions used as `thread_flags_group_join(&group)` and `thread_flags_group_set(&group, flag)`. A thread that calls `thread_flags_group_join()` before waiting must later be woken by `thread_flags_group_set()` only when the set flags include a flag it is waiting for, while threads not in the group must not be signaled by that group. The capability must work for the configured maximum thread count, including cases with more than 32 threads.
